objs.name: document
objs.description: A versioned artifact managed through creation, editing, review, release, and archival workflows in the P&R Management system.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document (Policy, Guideline, Procedure, Work Instruction, etc.)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of document (Creation, Review, Released, Out of Force, Archived)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for released or edited versions of a document

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when document validity expires and must be reviewed

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Textual or multimedia substance of the document

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code assigned to document for identification

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplementing a main document, released with it, affecting its version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of attachment (Creation, Review, Released, Archived)

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary document content not subject to the main document's release cycle, deletable without version impact.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether additional info is visible to readers

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested amendment to an existing document managed independently from its version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manual request to review and extend a document's validity period.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of request (Created, Approved, Rejected, Deleted)

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of request (Created, Approved, Rejected, Deleted)

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore an archived document to active use.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person assigned roles and permissions in the P&R Management system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Functional designation (Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator, Admin)

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Assignment of users or user groups to receive a document through email notification or acknowledgement workflow.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system with document type and optional template selection.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the textual or multimedia substance of a document in editing status.

evts.name: maintain_properties
evts.description: Update document metadata, attributes, and control settings including references and validity dates.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read, write, or specific role-based permissions to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Transition document from creation to review workflow step with author signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Perform technical and formal content evaluation by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document by assigned releaser(s) with electronic signature.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as no longer relevant to a document version, scheduled for archival on next release.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to authorized readers after approval.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose amendments to an existing document without affecting its version or release status.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Mark a change proposal for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm validity of a document and update its valid-until date by the standard extension period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate formal process to declare a document invalid and archive it.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Officially invalidate a document and revoke all user permissions except archive group access.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate formal process to restore an archived document to active use.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Approve reactivation and restore a previously invalidated document with updated version and status.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users or user groups of document release via email.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Prompt assigned users or user groups to actively confirm receipt of a document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user workflow-supported confirmation of document receipt without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-specific version of a released document for non-original language users.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Perform technical and formal evaluation of a translated document version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version to authorized readers in target language.

evts.name: generate_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System automatic creation of validity review request 30 days before document expires.

A document has zero or more distribution lists for email notification or acknowledgement
